'''Klay Firewell''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|boy]] who was a native of [[Corulag/Legends|Corulag]].

In [[23 BBY/Legends|23 BBY]], [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Calvaria]] of [[Nallastia]] had about 20 of her [[warrior]]s ambush and kidnap his parents, [[Hondu Firewell|Hondu]] and [[Tattyra Firewell]]. Having come to Nallastia for a [[Zoologist/Legends|zoological]] expedition, to study the indigenous fauna, the Firewells unlawfully trespassed (even though they possessed tourist passes issued by the office of [[Fondor/Legends|Fondor's]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]], whose authority the warriors did not recognize: they served only the [[Skull Queen]]). As a result, Princess Calvaria imprisoned the couple within an [[Force field/Legends|energy field]].

In the foothills of Nallastia's [[Volcano/Legends|volcanic]] [[Mount Octan]], Klay soon met and befriended the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], who—remembering [[Shmi Skywalker Lars/Legends|his own mother]], bound against her will to [[Slavery/Legends|slavery]]—traveled to the [[Skull Queen's fortress]] and took the princess hostage, in order to bargain for the release of Klay's parents. Calvaria's mother, the [[Margravine]] [[Quenelle]], acquiesced and teamed up with Skywalker's [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], to locate the [[Lost Stars of Nallastia]], three ancient jewels that could disable the energy field. The hunt was a success, culminating in the [[Cavern of Screaming Skulls]], and Klay's parents were freed.
